definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own older sister when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}しています→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧。
{姉|あね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧です。
examples.english: My older sister is a nurse.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}しました→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with my older sister.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}して→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いています→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My older sister graduated from university and is now working at a company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→ころ：03091_koro⟧、{姉|あね}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ものです。{姉|あね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{優|やさ}しかった→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧です。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played with my older sister. She was always kind.

notes:
{姉|あね} is the humble term for one's own older sister, used when speaking to people outside the family.

FAMILY TERM SYSTEM:
- {姉|あね}: my older sister (humble, to outsiders)
- ⟦お{姉|ねえ}さん→お姉さん：02859_oneesan⟧: older sister (polite, someone else's or direct address)
- ⟦お{姉|ねえ}ちゃん→お姉ちゃん：27278_oneechan⟧: big sis (casual, direct address within family)

USAGE:
Within the family, children often call their older sister ⟦お{姉|ねえ}ちゃん→お姉ちゃん：27278_oneechan⟧ or by name. {姉|あね} is specifically for describing your sister to others.

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧: my older brother (humble)
- ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧: my younger brother (humble)
- ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧: my younger sister (humble)

The pattern is consistent: plain forms for your own family members, お〜さん forms for others' family members or polite address.
